stepExplanation:
Taking the direction of the 1500 kg car as positive:
$$m_1v_1 + m_2v_2 = (m_1 + m_2)v_f$$
$$(1500)(20) + (1000)(-15) = (1500 + 1000)v_f$$
$$30000 - 15000 = 2500v_f$$
$$15000 = 2500v_f$$
$$v_f = 6 \text{ m/s}$$
The positive answer means they move in the direction of the heavier car.
stepBody: Taking the direction of the 1500 kg car as positive (so the 1000 kg car has velocity -15 m/s), calculate the common velocity after collision. Give your answer in m/s.
